description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Web General Session Object, including getters and setters for session properties, connection info, and lifecycle management functions.

methods.name: WebGsoGetHfpIf
methods.description: Returns the handle to the HFP interface associated with the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoSetHfpIf
methods.description: Sets the handle to the HFP interface for the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoGetActiveSocket
methods.description: Retrieves the active socket handle associated with the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoSetActiveSocket
methods.description: Sets the active socket handle for the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoGetSessionId
methods.description: Gets the session ID of the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoSetSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID for the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoGetClientAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the client address associated with the session.

methods.name: WebGsoSetClientAddr
methods.description: Sets the client address for the session.

methods.name: WebGsoGetClientPort
methods.description: Gets the client port number.

methods.name: WebGsoSetClientPort
methods.description: Sets the client port number.

methods.name: WebGsoGetLsmContext
methods.description: Retrieves the LSM context handle.

methods.name: WebGsoSetLsmContext
methods.description: Sets the LSM context handle.

methods.name: WebGsoGetLsmIdentifier
methods.description: Gets the LSM identifier string.

methods.name: WebGsoSetLsmIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the LSM identifier string.

methods.name: WebGsoGetLsmMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum age for LSM.

methods.name: WebGsoSetLsmMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum age for LSM.

methods.name: WebGsoGetLsmExpire
methods.description: Gets the LSM expiration time.

methods.name: WebGsoSetLsmExpire
methods.description: Sets the LSM expiration time.

methods.name: WebGsoGetMaxLifespan
methods.description: Returns the maximum lifespan of the session.

methods.name: WebGsoSetMaxLifespan
methods.description: Sets the maximum lifespan for the session.

methods.name: WebGsoReset
methods.description: Resets the WebGso object's state.

methods.name: WebGsoGetAuthSessInfo
methods.description: Retrieves authentication session information.

methods.name: WebGsoAcquireAccess
methods.description: Acquires access to the WebGso object, likely for thread synchronization.

methods.name: WebGsoReleaseAccess
methods.description: Releases previously acquired access.

methods.name: WebGsoEngage
methods.description: Engages or activates the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoCancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing operations on the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoTerminate
methods.description: Terminates or cleans up the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoLock
methods.description: Locks the WebGso object, possibly for thread safety.

methods.name: WebGsoUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks the WebGso object.

methods.name: WebGsoResetTimestamp
methods.description: Resets timestamp or timing information related to the session.
